data.intent: Stage new GitHub signals: release assets, stargazer and fork days, issues/PRs, package downloads, repo vitals
data.next: review the diffs, then `transform apply pd93b32993a`

+from {{ source('raw', 'stargazer_days') }}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/models/staging/stg_fork_days.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+select md5(cast(repository as varchar) || '|' || cast(date as varchar)) as fork_day_source_key,

+from {{ source('raw', 'fork_days') }}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/models/staging/stg_issues.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+select md5(cast(repository as varchar) || '|' || cast(number as varchar)) as issue_source_key,

+from {{ source('raw', 'issues') }}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/models/staging/stg_package_downloads.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+select md5(cast(repository as varchar) || '|' || registry || '|' || package || '|' || cast(date as varchar)) as package_download_source_key,

+    data_tests:
